build.reason: build.sh compiles checksum_fuzzer.c against the changed header. Its two-argument crc32_combine_gen calls conflict with the new one-argument declaration; its array operator also conflicts with the scalar crc32_combine_op declaration.

input.reason: An empty fuzz input reaches data[0] before the dataLen < 1 guard, reading outside the supplied input. The checksum functions themselves accept an empty or null buffer initialization.

lifecycle.reason: The target uses checksum values and a stack operator array; these calls create no resource or state requiring cleanup.

control_flow.reason: Compilation prevents entry execution. Independently, the entry reads the first byte before its size guard, so its empty-input path is invalid.

accepted.requirement: Compile checksum_fuzzer.c using the changed CRC combine generator and operator signatures.
accepted.target_route: build.sh invokes configure and make, then compiles each *_fuzzer.c, including checksum_fuzzer.c, against zlib.h.
accepted.failure_condition: The target calls crc32_combine_gen(op, length), but the changed declaration takes only length and returns uLong. The target passes op[32] to crc32_combine_op, whose changed third parameter is uLong.
accepted.alternative_paths: The old target has no conditional compilation or alternate combine call sequence; both incompatible calls are in its complete entry body.
